title: Netgear FA311 32-Bit PCI Adapter 10/100 Fast Ethernet Card New Sealed

descriptionText:
Netgear FA311 32-bit PCI Adapter, 10/100 Mbps Fast Ethernet card. Factory sealed, new in original retail box — never opened.
Compatible with Windows 95/98/NT/2000/XP, Novell NetWare, and Linux. Includes the network card, installation guide, and installation disk. Ships well-packed.
